name: Karl Koscher
biography: (@supersat) is a PhD student studying security and privacy at the University of Washington. His research covers a wide variety of areas, but he primarily focuses on security for embedded systems. Most recently, he was one of the primary researchers that demonstrated that modern cars are vulnerable to multiple remote exploits, which can affect nearly every physical system in the car.
